roadsAndWater.modifications: Selected roads and water around Seoul; coordinate precision rounded, roads simplified approximately 6 m and grouped by highway class. Secondary roads limited to Gangnam context. Other original OSM polygons preserved with islands.

fiction: RP locations must be separately marked as fictional, approximate placements. No private-address or device-location data is included.
